package position

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdatePositionTechs updates position tech links.
type UpdatePositionTechs struct {
	Positions repository.PositionRepository
	Techs     repository.PositionTechRepository
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle replaces technologies for a position.
func (uc UpdatePositionTechs) Handle(ctx context.Context, positionID int, techIDs []int) error {
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Positions.GetByID(ctx, positionID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.Techs.Replace(ctx, positionID, techIDs)
	})
}
